scope: Migrate BMI088 and BuzzerAlarm to the HFUT-WDR namespace and add intermittent calibration buzzer prompts to BMI088 and Gimbal

gimbal.lock_source: local bundle until the commit is pushed to HFUT-WDR/Gimbal

migration.history_and_license: Upstream history and LICENSE preserved; UPSTREAM.md added to both migrated repositories
migration.lock: modules.yaml, module_sources/HFUT-WDR/index.yaml and xrobot.lock updated; old Modules/xrobot-org copies moved to .cache/retired_modules

module_changes.BuzzerAlarm: Added non-blocking StartTone(freq, duty) / StopTone(); Play(freq, duration, duty) keeps the original 0.005 default duty for the startup tune and fatal alarm
module_changes.BMI088: Optional BuzzerAlarm* buzzer; bmi088 cali beeps at start, every 3 s during sampling, every 1 s during the quality check (800 Hz/4%, 80 ms), and three times at completion
module_changes.Gimbal: Optional BuzzerAlarm* calibration_buzzer at the end of the constructor; CALI beeps every 2 s (800 Hz/4%, 80 ms), scheduled without blocking the 1 ms control thread, and stops on completion, failure or exit

checks.host_notes: Added tests/gimbal/stubs/BuzzerAlarm.hpp; external module isolation now expects the HFUT-WDR module ids

hardware.buzzer_pwm: TIM12 CH2 CC2E enabled; CCR2/ARR matched the configured duty during the continuous-tone iterations and the final intermittent 800 Hz/4% beeps
hardware.calibration_run: bmi088 cali completed in about 50 s (30 s sampling + 15 s quality), offset saved as {0.005551, -0.002516, -0.004179} rad/s
hardware.reset_load: After reset bmi088 list_offset returned the same offset, confirming flash load
hardware.note: The board may have been disturbed during the calibration run; the value verifies the read/write path, not the final zero offset

unverified: Gimbal CALI buzzer prompts not tested on hardware; requires motors and the mechanism
Final tone frequency, duty and intervals await operator acceptance
HFUT-WDR/BMI088 and HFUT-WDR/BuzzerAlarm GitHub repositories not created or pushed; ModuleIndex not updated
HFUT-WDR/Gimbal commit not pushed; lock temporarily uses the local bundle
Cold power-loss during calibration not tested
